correctness.rationale: All hypotheses and normalizations are specified: k≥2, m=k!, every permutation checkerboard, unit Dirichlet simplex, independent unit exponentials within k. A finite-population covariance identity gives K⊗K exactly; the single-cell remainder bounds K-B by 1/(4k). Lyapunov bound \(O(k^{3/2}/\sqrt{k!})\) yields finite-dimensional Gaussianity, and Rosenthal eighth moments \(\le C\|z-w\|_1^4\) yield \(C([0,1]^2)\) tightness; scalar denominator tends to one. Green-matrix inversion verifies eigenvalues, while Chebyshev/union/Borel–Cantelli verifies unscaled almost-sure uniform collapse without cross-k independence. Standalone enumeration, eigenpairs, simulation actually passed; numerical tests alone are not treated as proof.
